topic: Application of servo motors in automatic trim control
syllabus_extract: Application of servo motors in automatic trim control.
specific_objectives: 14.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the functions of AFCS.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of AFCS block diagram and servo motor feedback loop principles from IB/PDF.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the AFCS?
How does manual trim differ from automatic trim?
Why is servo motor application necessary in modern AFCS?

development.content:
AFCS role in automatic trim
Servo motor actuation mechanism
Feedback loop operation
Trim signal processing

Servo motor torque characteristics
Error signal generation
Stability and damping effects

Integration with flight control computers
Fail-safe trim mechanisms
Maintenance considerations

summary_questions: Explain how the AFCS uses servo motors to adjust trim automatically.
Describe the role of the feedback loop in maintaining trim stability.
What are the key maintenance checks for servo motors in the trim system?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of servo motor application in automatic trim control relate to the flap compensating circuit discussed in LP 02.
